title: Generate the candidate audit bundle and pass automated no-repeat gates
description:
Generate the CANDIDATE audit bundle from the migrated corpus and prove it passes
every AUTOMATED closure gate. Independent human/model review is deliberately NOT
part of this bead — that is eshyra-o9bd.16, and acceptance of its result is
19.6.4.

Enforced progression (do not short-circuit):
  19.6.1 full corpus migration
    -> 19.6.2 permanent regression and finding closure
      -> 19.6.3 candidate bundle + automated no-repeat gates   (this bead)
        -> eshyra-o9bd.16 independent max-effort re-audit
          -> 19.6.4 accept results and certify zero-repeat closure
            -> eshyra-o9bd.14 formal regeneration and re-freeze
              -> eshyra-2zyy re-enable post-freeze thaw-note gating
acceptance_criteria:
- All normal CI and deterministic regeneration pass.
- Source and output reconciliation pass in BOTH directions.
- Zero unresolved ownership.
- Zero unsupported source-backed output.
- Zero partial deterministic clauses hidden behind mechanics presence.
- Zero pending engine gaps without beads.
- Every finding registry row has closure evidence and an automated predicate that currently passes.
- The candidate bundle is handed to eshyra-o9bd.16 for independent review; this bead does NOT assert review outcomes.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
